text_block_list.text:
Failing to take first place, Symboli
Rudolf
resolves to do better at the
Satsuki Sho. All the
same, her
performance seems to have intimidated

the general manager.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Симболи Рудольф
encounters
Марузенски, the "Beast."
Much like Rudolf,
Марузенски's
formidable skills have made her the
talk
of the racing world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Could this potential rivalry bring out a
new side
of Симболи Рудольф? I can't help
but wonder what
the future might hold.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
